name: Marko Babić
bio:
Marko Babić's journey into motorsport security was unconventional. After serving in the Croatian military police, his sharp eye for detail and strategic thinking caught the attention of a private security firm specializing in high-profile events. His first motorsport assignment was securing a small rally stage, but he quickly rose through the ranks, demonstrating an uncanny ability to anticipate potential security breaches and maintain order in chaotic environments. 

At Team WRT, Marko is known for his meticulous approach to security protocols. He emphasizes preventative measures and rigorous training for his team. His demanding nature stems from his belief that even the smallest lapse in security can have disastrous consequences. He’s constantly pushing for innovation in security technology and procedures, ensuring the team is always one step ahead of potential threats. Marko's dedication and proactive approach make him a valuable asset to the team, guaranteeing the safety and integrity of their operations.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed military cut with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: A broad-shouldered man with a serious demeanor and a piercing gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, jotting down observations and potential security risks.
Insists on performing random security checks, much to the annoyance of some team members.
Has a habit of speaking in military jargon when under pressure.
